title: AI in Japan—OpenAI’s Japan Economic Blueprint
summary: OpenAI’s Japan Economic Blueprint outlines how Japan can harness AI to boost innovation, strengthen competitiveness, and enable sustainable, inclusive growth.
body: OpenAI’s Japan Economic Blueprint outlines how Japan can harness AI to boost innovation, strengthen competitiveness, and enable sustainable, inclusive growth.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布《日本经济蓝图》，阐述如何帮助日本利用人工智能技术推动本土创新并增强竞争力。该文件体现了OpenAI在亚太地区的政策合作倾向与战略布局。
